bio.text: Dave Min was elected in 2024 to represent California's 47th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives.
He served as a California State Senator from 2020 to 2024, and was previously a law professor at UC Irvine.
He earned degrees from the University of Pennsylvania and Harvard Law School, and began his career as an Enforcement Attorney at the Securities and Exchange Commission.
He lives in Irvine with his wife, Jane, and their three children.
